evidence.title: PatchWrite: One Line, Not One Section -- Compile-Gated, Validity-Preserving Editing for AI-Drafted Manuscripts

summary: PatchWrite unveils a compile-gated editing tool that allows precise, validity-preserving modifications to AI-drafted manuscripts with minimal input. The system ensures structural and semantic integrity while streamlining the revision process.
title: PatchWrite Introduces One-Line AI Manuscript Editing with Validity Preservation
